title: Dynamical Poles in Non-Hermitian Impurity Scattering
summary: In Hermitian impurity scattering, each isolated late-time exponential is the fingerprint of a bound state. We show that this correspondence breaks down in non-Hermitian bands. For a single impurity in a non-Hermitian lattice, the late-time signal is controlled by isolated complex frequencies selected by the analytic continuation of the Green's function relevant to real-time dynamics, which we term dynamical poles (DPs).
